basic_details.job_title: SNLU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

important_dates.interview_date: To be announced for short-listed candidates

application_fee.details: The application fee must be paid online via RTGS/NEFT in favour of Sikkim National Law University, Account No. 44472530012, State Bank of India, IFSC Code SBIN0007950. The payment receipt must be attached as an annexure. The application fee is non-refundable, and applications without proof of fee payment will be rejected.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | assistant professor of law: A Master’s degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Plus, cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET, or awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with UGC Regulations 2009/2016. Alternatively, a Ph.D. degree obtained from a foreign university/institution ranked among the top 500 in World University Ranking by QS, Times Higher Education, or ARWU.

selection_process: The selection process consists of short-listing of applications followed by an interview for short-listed candidates.

Only short-listed candidates will be called for an interview. Candidates must produce original documents for verification at the time of the interview. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.
how_to_apply: Download the official application form from the official website.
Fill out the application form completely with all required details.
Pay the prescribed application fee online via RTGS/NEFT to the specified bank account.
Gather self-attested copies of all certificates, mark sheets, proof of qualifications, teaching/research experience certificates, date of birth proof, and the online payment receipt.
Send the filled-up application form along with all relevant documents and proof of payments to the Registrar, Sikkim National Law University, via email at [email protected] by 5:00 PM on 30.10.2026.
important_instructions: Applications received without proof of payment of the application fee will be rejected. Incomplete applications or applications without relevant supporting self-attested enclosures will be rejected at the threshold. Candidates belonging to SC/ST must submit appropriate certificates issued by the competent authority in the format prescribed by the Government of India. The University reserves the right not to fill up any of the advertised positions or to increase/decrease the number of positions. Candidates attempting to lobby or canvass to influence the selection process will be disqualified. The University will not be responsible for any non-receipt or delay of application sent by a candidate.
